items.title: Halftime: #Magic 57, Kings 52
items.author: Jason Beede
items.body_excerpt:
Halftime: #Magic 57, Kings 52

Franz Wagner and Anthony Black with 16 points apiece. Nine points for Desmond Bane, who's gotten some decent looks from 3 but is only 2-for-6.

Also some nice effort from two-way forward Alex Morales, who has 5 points and 4 rebounds in 12 minutes.

items.title: Jaylen Brown: “I felt good. I felt fine. I felt athletic.” Says the two early fouls made it hard for him to find a rhythm. Asked about Jayson Tatum trying to greet him pregame, he said he is just trying to focus on helping his team win.
items.author: Adam Aaronson
items.body_excerpt:
Jaylen Brown: “I felt good. I felt fine. I felt athletic.” Says the two early fouls made it hard for him to find a rhythm. Asked about Jayson Tatum trying to greet him pregame, he said he is just trying to focus on helping his team win.

“Credit to Jayson. Credit to the Celtics.”
